text:
maya: Heads-up — I'm getting reports that a canary left raw PII in transient logs. route /generate, rollout 2112340000.
chen: which canary?
maya: the routing-fallback from yesterday. a couple of long `user_message` entries landed in transient inspect logs.
sahil: current sampler = size-based + route exemptions. if payload > 2k we drop tokens, but inspect-mode still persists full JSON.
amanda: do we even have a console flag that marks a canary as "inspect mode"? that should never be default for prod.
maya: ops playbook enabled it temporarily. ops-bot: alert — debug-inspect enabled for route /generate for 12h by sahil.
chen: proposal:
- redact PII before any transient write
- a fast pre-sampler (hash) to avoid running full redaction on 99% of requests
- "exposure" rules: detect runs of digits / ssn-like patterns, or long sequences after name/email
- if any redaction rule matched, don't persist raw body unless approved
sahil: two-pass sampler looks good. quick hash sample decides whether to queue for expensive redaction. also suggest deterministic salted-per-tenant HMAC for PII fingerprints.
amanda: UX: we need an "approve-to-retain" flow in Console. show "request retained" badge + require 2 approvers to keep raw payload >24h. audit trail required.
maya: prefer opt-in by team with audit. add telemetry events: `retention.requested`, `retention.approved`, `redaction.rule_matched`.
chen: config sketch:
```yaml
logging:
  sampler:
    fast_hash: true
    sample_rate: 0.01
  redaction:
    enabled: true
    ruleset: default-pii-v2
    max_digits_run: 5
    max_exposed_chars: 6
  retention:
    raw_payload: "conditional"
    approval_required: 2
```
sahil: exposure as absolute chars + digit-run sounds simpler than fraction.
amanda: add console "breakglass" for SRE+owner: temporary inspect with elevated audit, auto-delete after 12h, requires ticket link.
maya: hotfix: flip inspect-mode default off for the canary route and set retention to conditional. I'll push flag change now and open an approval-flow ticket.
chen: add a smoke test: send fake SSN and assert transient logs contain redacted token/hash, not cleartext.
ops-bot: deploy scheduled: feature/inspect-toggle -> prod in 18m.
sahil: follow-up RFC next week for sampler redesign + console flow. assign @chen for smoke tests, @amanda for UX mocks, @maya for feature-flag PR.
